stem:
The graph shows rainfall in millimetres for stations P and Q across four months that Imran recorded in order. He is choosing between this line graph and a display with many clustered bars.

Which claim about this display is correct?

options.text: The display is a chart of clustered bars for the four months.
Month order can be ignored because the points are already plotted.
The line graph compares the two stations across the ordered months more clearly than many clustered bars.
Only the highest rainfall point on the graph matters for the comparison.

teacher.key_rationale: Two time series over ordered months are clearer as lines than as many clustered bars. Calling it a bar chart misnames the display. Dropping month order or using only the peak misses how the comparison runs across time.
teacher.figure_note: Added dual line series for stations P and Q over four months.
